WITH usage_by_product AS (
  SELECT sm.product_id, sm.product_name, sm.sku, COALESCE(SUM(ABS(sm.quantity)), 0) AS consumed_quantity
  FROM agent_v3_stock_movement_view AS sm
  WHERE sm.store_id = ANY(:allowedStoreIds)
    AND sm.occurred_at >= :startAt::timestamptz
    AND sm.occurred_at < :endAt::timestamptz
    AND sm.quantity < 0
    AND sm.product_name LIKE '***'
  GROUP BY sm.product_id, sm.product_name, sm.sku
)
SELECT pi.product_id, pi.product_name, pi.sku, COALESCE(MAX(ubp.consumed_quantity), 0) AS consumed_quantity, MAX(pi.current_stock) AS current_stock
FROM agent_v3_product_inventory_view AS pi
LEFT JOIN usage_by_product AS ubp
  ON pi.product_id = ubp.product_id
WHERE pi.store_id = ANY(:allowedStoreIds)
  AND pi.product_name LIKE '***'
GROUP BY pi.product_id, pi.product_name, pi.sku
LIMIT 100;
